trail-clear.goal: Place every tile. Close roads and rivers to clear them.
trail-clear.how-to-play.step-1: Drag the tile onto the board.
trail-clear.how-to-play.step-2: Edges must match: road to road, river to river.
trail-clear.how-to-play.step-3: A road or river with no loose end is cleared.
trail-clear.how-to-play.step-4: One tile can close a road and a river at once.
trail-clear.name: Trail Clear
trail-clear.tagline: Match the edges. Close the loops.
trail-clear.tutorial.step-1: Drag this tile between the two ends.
trail-clear.tutorial.step-2: Pick how the tile faces, then place it.
trail-clear.tutorial.step-3: Close a road or a river to clear its tiles.
trail-clear.tutorial.step-4: Place every tile to win. Keep room on the board!
